clips.title: The story
paras: Balthule Shadowstrike sends a warning from the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore. His letter to Delgren the Purifier describes the Dark Strand cult's demonic work and must reach Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

Balthule Shadowstrike watches the Dark Strand cult gather around the Tower of Althalaxx ruins. He cannot destroy the cult alone, so he writes to Delgren the Purifier, his tutor in the Holy Light, asking for aid. The cult's foul rites threaten more than Darkshore's coast. The letter must travel south through the region into western Ashenvale, where Delgren works with night elf Sentinels against demonic and undead threats.
